tei:div.tei:p: /smon lam rdo rje'i rgya mdud ni/ /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsol/ /deng 'dir brtson pas bsgrubs pa'i dge ba dang*/ /dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bsdoms te bla med byang chub chen por bsngo/ /deng nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*/ /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan/ /dpal ldan rdo rje'i theg la nges gnas shog /dbang gis smin cing dam tshig sdom par ldan/ /rim gnyis lam la bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin te/ /dka' ba med par rig 'dzin go 'phang bgrod/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag 'grub gyur cig /cir snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lor rdzogs/ /grags pa thams cad brjod bral sngags kyi sgra/ /sems kyi 'gyu ba rang rig 'dus ma byas/ /bde chen 'du 'bral med par mngon gyur shog /nyams chags rtog sgrib ma spangs gnas su dag /phyi nang gsang ba dbyer med rtogs pas skongs/ /gang shar rang grol kun bzang klong yangs su/ /ngan song dong sprugs srid zhi mnyam gyur cig /thig le chen por sku dang zhing khams rdzogs/ /dam tshig chen por spangs blang mtshan ma dag /khyab brdal chen por re dogs mdud pa grol/ /rdzogs pa chen por chos sku mngon gyur shog /brgyud pa gsum gyi byin brlabs snying la zhugs/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lam gsang sems la rdzogs/ /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa yis/ /mu mtha' med pa'i 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /zhi khro sprul pa'i 'khor los lung ston zhing*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bu bzhin skyong ba dang*/ /chos skyong srung mas bar chad kun bsal nas/ /yid la smon pa mtha' dag 'grub gyur cig /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ /bstan 'dzin rnams kyis bzhed pa'i don kun 'grub/ /ma lus skye rgu'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*/ /phun tshogs mtha' dag yid bzhin 'byor gyur cig

ye dharma brjod cing zhwa bzhes bkra shis brjod do/ /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rnam rgyas 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /des ni khyod la de ring zhi byed bkra shis shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab g.yo med pa/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /des ni khyod la de ring zhi byed bkra shis shog /dam chos ldan pa thos pa'i bkra shis kyis phyug cing*/ /dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha min yon gyi gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /des ni khyod la de ring zhi byed bkra shis shog /che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde gyur cig /ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog

/rgyal ba sras bcas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsam pa dang*/ /gsang sngags rigs sngags rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*/ /bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis/ /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*/ /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa ste/ /gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*/ /'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa ste/ /bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung ba ste/ /lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang*/ /bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*/ /mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa ste/ /drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir stsol/ /dpal ldan bla mas deng 'dir stsol/ /yi dam lha yis deng 'dir stsol/ /chos skyong srung mas deng 'dir stsol/ /gzhi bdag rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur tam/ /sa 'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod par shog /'dir ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /shin tu bden par gsungs shing rdzun med pa/ /bden pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /de kun 'jig pa che las thar gyur cig /deng 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi gnod pa las grol ba bzhin du bdud dang spang bya bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig

/dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsams gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sa la 'og min oX rgyanaX mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ /gnyis pa smina~X cing grolaX ba a ti'i glingaX*/ /ngesaX paX don gyi dga'aX ba'iX tshalaX chen po/ /phyog dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par shog //
